conservacion.ayuda_texto: Closed cases appear when their retention period ends. Two different Administration users must review removal of personal data. Audit links are retained and remain subject to the Data Protection Officer’s decision. The initial period is 25 years; publish a different period using the key conservacion and the unit anos.
conservacion.editar_plazo: Go to Time limits and ranges
conservacion.error: The operation could not be completed. Refresh the list before trying again.
conservacion.conflicto: The case or retention period has changed. Refresh the list and review it again.
conservacion.no_permitida: The conditions for confirmation are not met. Refresh the list and check the status.
conservacion.vacio: There are no cases awaiting review or anonymised cases whose retention period has ended.
conservacion.consecuencia_final: Names, contact details and free text will be removed from this case, including its historical copies. This cannot be undone. Statistics and audit links will be retained.
conservacion.consecuencia_propuesta: You will record the first review. Personal data will be removed after another Administration user reviews and confirms the proposal.
conservacion.revisado: I have reviewed the case number, the retention period and the scope of removal.
conservacion.hecho: Personal data removed. Statistics and audit links are retained.
conservacion.propuesta_hecha: First review recorded. Another Administration user must review and confirm.
conservacion.sin_permiso: Your session does not allow this action. Sign in again with an Administration profile.
